name: Booking provisioning (payment -> booking)
description: Of successful booking-fee payments, what share have a matching booking-fee-captured record against that same transaction?
query:
-- Booking Provisioning (Payment -> Booking) % — 9 windows, cohort by booking-fee-payment date (IST).
-- Product Health: CX. Event-level (per transaction, NOT per mobile) — a customer with 2 separate
-- booking-fee payments (e.g. installed once this month, once before) contributes 2 independent rows,
-- one per transaction, each checked against its OWN booking-fee-captured record.
-- Denominator = successful booking-fee-payment transactions: WIOM_BILLING_WIFI rows where
--   extra_data:flow='Booking', extra_data:paymentKey='bookingPayment',
--   extra_data:queueKeyName='BOOKING_CAPTURE_PAYMENT', payment_status=1.
-- Numerator = that transaction_id appears as DYNAMODB.BOOKING.booking_payment_txn_id with payment_status=6
--   (booking-fee-captured, recorded against the SAME transaction — history-preserving, not current-state).
-- VALIDATION: traced mobile 8826776490 (2 booking-fee payments, Jan 2026 + May 2026) — both transaction_ids
-- matched a distinct booking_payment_txn_id/payment_status=6 row. At population scale this gives a PERFECT
-- 100% match for Feb-Jul 2026 (99.5-100% for M-2/M-3), replacing every earlier proxy (ADDED_TIME/MODIFIED_TIME
-- proximity, LeadStatus.STATUS heuristics) which were all approximations of this exact, authoritative signal.
-- NOTE: match rate collapses for payments before ~Sep 2025 (down to ~0% before Aug 2025) — PAYMENT_STATUS=6
-- tracking on DYNAMODB.BOOKING was not reliably populated before then; irrelevant for this 9-window (D-1..M-3) scope.
WITH w AS (SELECT DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))-1 d1,DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))-2 d2,DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))-3 d3,
  DATEADD('day',-7,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w1f, DATEADD('day',-1,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w1t,
  DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w2f, DATEADD('day',-8,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w2t,
  DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w3f, DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w3t,
  DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) m1f, DATEADD('day',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) m1t,
  DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) m2f, DATEADD('day',-1,DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))))) m2t,
  DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) m3f, DATEADD('day',-1,DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))))) m3t),
pay AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT transaction_id, TO_DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,create_date)) cdate
  FROM PROD_DB.DYNAMODB.WIOM_BILLING_WIFI
  WHERE mobile > '5999999999'
    AND try_parse_json(extra_data):"flow"::string = 'Booking'
    AND try_parse_json(extra_data):"paymentKey"::string = 'bookingPayment'
    AND try_parse_json(extra_data):"queueKeyName"::string = 'BOOKING_CAPTURE_PAYMENT'
    AND payment_status = 1
),
bk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT booking_payment_txn_id
  FROM PROD_DB.DYNAMODB.BOOKING
  WHERE payment_status = 6 AND booking_payment_txn_id IS NOT NULL
),
f AS (
  SELECT p.cdate, IFF(bk.booking_payment_txn_id IS NOT NULL,1,0) has_booking
  FROM pay p LEFT JOIN bk ON bk.booking_payment_txn_id = p.transaction_id
)
SELECT 'Booking Provisioning (Payment -> Booking) %' "KPI",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d1 THEN has_booking END)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d1 THEN 1 END),0),2) "D-1",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d2 THEN has_booking END)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d2 THEN 1 END),0),2) "D-2",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d3 THEN has_booking END)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d3 THEN 1 END),0),2) "D-3",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w1f AND w.w1t THEN has_booking END)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w1f AND w.w1t THEN 1 END),0),2) "W-1",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w2f AND w.w2t THEN has_booking END)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w2f AND w.w2t THEN 1 END),0),2) "W-2",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w3f AND w.w3t THEN has_booking END)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w3f AND w.w3t THEN 1 END),0),2) "W-3",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m1f AND w.m1t THEN has_booking END)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m1f AND w.m1t THEN 1 END),0),2) "M-1",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m2f AND w.m2t THEN has_booking END)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m2f AND w.m2t THEN 1 END),0),2) "M-2",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m3f AND w.m3t THEN has_booking END)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m3f AND w.m3t THEN 1 END),0),2) "M-3"
FROM f CROSS JOIN w;

  SELECT DISTINCT mobile, transaction_id, DATEADD(minute,330,create_date) AS pay_ist, TO_DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,create_date)) cdate
  FROM PROD_DB.DYNAMODB.WIOM_BILLING_WIFI

    AND try_parse_json(extra_data):"queueKeyName"::string = 'BOOKING_CAPTURE_PAYMENT'
    AND payment_status = 1
),

  SELECT DISTINCT booking_payment_txn_id
  FROM PROD_DB.DYNAMODB.BOOKING
  WHERE payment_status = 6 AND booking_payment_txn_id IS NOT NULL
),
bk_any AS (
  SELECT booking_payment_txn_id, MAX(payment_status) AS any_status
  FROM PROD_DB.DYNAMODB.BOOKING

name: Address Submitted -> Booking Confirmed (24h) %
description: Of customers who submitted an address (address_updated event) -- counting only their first submission, or their first since a prior booking was cancelled (cancelled event) -- what share had their booking confirmed (booking_confirmed event) within 24 hours? D-1 only counts address submissions that have themselves completed a full 24 hours, so it never shows a partial, still-maturing day.
query:
WITH addr_raw AS (
  SELECT MOBILE, DATEADD(minute,330,ADDED_TIME) AS addr_ist
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKING_LOGS
  WHERE event_name='address_updated' AND MOBILE > '5999999999' AND ADDED_TIME IS NOT NULL
    AND ADDED_TIME >= DATEADD(day,-150,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MOBILE, ADDED_TIME ORDER BY 1) = 1
),
cancel_raw AS (
  SELECT MOBILE, DATEADD(minute,330,ADDED_TIME) AS cancel_ist
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKING_LOGS
  WHERE event_name='cancelled' AND MOBILE > '5999999999' AND ADDED_TIME IS NOT NULL
    AND ADDED_TIME >= DATEADD(day,-150,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MOBILE, ADDED_TIME ORDER BY 1) = 1
),
-- merge address_updated + cancelled events per mobile, ordered by time, and count cancellations
-- seen so far -- a customer's address_updated events only start a NEW cycle once a cancelled
-- event has happened in between; otherwise they collapse into their first-ever cycle
combined AS (
  SELECT MOBILE, addr_ist AS t, 'ADDR' AS kind FROM addr_raw
  UNION ALL
  SELECT MOBILE, cancel_ist AS t, 'CANCEL' AS kind FROM cancel_raw
),
running AS (
  SELECT MOBILE, t, kind,
   SUM(IFF(kind='CANCEL',1,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY MOBILE ORDER BY t ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cycle_id
  FROM combined
),
addr_tagged AS (
  SELECT MOBILE, t AS addr_ist, cycle_id
  FROM running
  WHERE kind = 'ADDR'
),
cycles AS ( -- one row per (mobile, cycle) -- first address_updated in that cycle
  SELECT MOBILE, cycle_id, MIN(addr_ist) AS addr_ist
  FROM addr_tagged
  GROUP BY MOBILE, cycle_id
),
confirm AS ( -- CHANGE: confirm signal now sourced from BOOKING_LOGS (booking_confirmed event),
             -- not COMPANY_B_CONNECTION_BOOKING_ENRICHED.BOOKING_CONFIRM_TIME
  SELECT MOBILE, DATEADD(minute,330,ADDED_TIME) AS confirm_time
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKING_LOGS
  WHERE event_name='booking_confirmed' AND MOBILE > '5999999999' AND ADDED_TIME IS NOT NULL
    AND ADDED_TIME >= DATEADD(day,-150,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MOBILE, ADDED_TIME ORDER BY 1) = 1
),
scored AS (
  SELECT c.MOBILE, c.addr_ist, TO_DATE(c.addr_ist) AS cdate,
    MAX(IFF(cf.confirm_time IS NOT NULL AND cf.confirm_time >= DATEADD('hour',-24,c.addr_ist) AND cf.confirm_time <= DATEADD('hour',24,c.addr_ist),1,0)) AS has_confirmed
  FROM cycles c LEFT JOIN confirm cf ON cf.MOBILE = c.MOBILE
  GROUP BY c.MOBILE, c.addr_ist
),
f AS ( -- only count an address_updated once it has completed a full 24h -- avoids showing a
       -- partial, artificially-low/incomplete D-1 computed from bookings too fresh to have confirmed yet
  SELECT * FROM scored WHERE addr_ist <= DATEADD('hour', -24, DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))
),
w AS (SELECT DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))-1 d1,DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))-2 d2,DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))-3 d3,
  DATEADD('day',-7,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w1f, DATEADD('day',-1,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w1t,
  DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w2f, DATEADD('day',-8,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w2t,
  DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w3f, DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) w3t,
  DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) m1f, DATEADD('day',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) m1t,
  DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) m2f, DATEADD('day',-1,DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))))) m2t,
  DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) m3f, DATEADD('day',-1,DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',DATE(DATEADD(minute,330,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()))))) m3t)
SELECT 'Address submitted to booking confirmed' AS "KPI",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d1 THEN has_confirmed END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d1 THEN 1 END),0),3) AS "D-1",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d2 THEN has_confirmed END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d2 THEN 1 END),0),3) AS "D-2",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d3 THEN has_confirmed END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate=w.d3 THEN 1 END),0),3) AS "D-3",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w1f AND w.w1t THEN has_confirmed END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w1f AND w.w1t THEN 1 END),0),3) AS "W-1",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w2f AND w.w2t THEN has_confirmed END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w2f AND w.w2t THEN 1 END),0),3) AS "W-2",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w3f AND w.w3t THEN has_confirmed END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w3f AND w.w3t THEN 1 END),0),3) AS "W-3",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m1f AND w.m1t THEN has_confirmed END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m1f AND w.m1t THEN 1 END),0),3) AS "M-1",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m2f AND w.m2t THEN has_confirmed END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m2f AND w.m2t THEN 1 END),0),3) AS "M-2",
 ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m3f AND w.m3t THEN has_confirmed END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m3f AND w.m3t THEN 1 END),0),3) AS "M-3"
FROM f CROSS JOIN w;

name: Install TRUM plan creation within 30 mins
description: Of installs that reached the AWAITING_CUSTOMER_OTP state, what share had their TRUM plan created within 30 minutes of reaching it?
query:
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today),
otp_entry AS (
  SELECT EXECUTION_CANDIDATE_ID, CONNECTION_ID, MIN(UPDATED_AT) AS otp_wait_ts
  FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES
  WHERE CURRENT_STATE = 'AWAITING_CUSTOMER_OTP'
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
conn AS (
  SELECT CONNECTION_ID, CUSTOMER_ID FROM PROD_DB.CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE_CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE.CONNECTIONS
  WHERE _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE
),
anchor_raw AS (   -- no timezone shift here: otp_wait_ts (genuine TIMESTAMP_TZ) vs otp_issued_time
                  -- (T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING's own raw convention) verified to align correctly as-is
                  -- for this specific pairing (99.7% match, median 0 min; cross-checked against a
                  -- ground-truth event match on a real install) -- do not add +330 here.
  SELECT w.MOBILE, w.NASID, oe.otp_wait_ts AS sc_ts
  FROM otp_entry oe
  JOIN conn c ON c.CONNECTION_ID = oe.CONNECTION_ID
  JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w ON w.ACCOUNT_ID = TRY_TO_NUMBER(c.CUSTOMER_ID)
),
test_partner_mobiles AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT MOBILE AS mobile FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING
  WHERE CREATED_BY IN (SELECT LCO_ACCOUNT_ID FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.TEST_LCO_ACCOUNT_ID)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT w.mobile FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w
  JOIN PROD_DB.CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE_CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE.CONNECTIONS c
    ON c.customer_id=w.account_id AND c._FIVETRAN_ACTIVE
  WHERE LOWER(c.CSP_ID) IN ('a0a0b1','a0a6w1')
),
anchor AS (
  SELECT a.* FROM anchor_raw a LEFT JOIN test_partner_mobiles tc ON tc.mobile=a.MOBILE
  WHERE tc.mobile IS NULL AND a.MOBILE > '5999999999'
),
trum_ok AS (
  SELECT a.MOBILE, a.sc_ts, MIN(ABS(DATEDIFF('minute', t.otp_issued_time, a.sc_ts))) gap_min
  FROM anchor a
  JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING t ON t.router_nas_id = a.NASID AND t.otp='DONE'
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
base AS (
  SELECT DATE(a.sc_ts) AS d, 1 AS den,
    CASE WHEN tr.gap_min<=30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS num
  FROM anchor a LEFT JOIN trum_ok tr ON tr.MOBILE=a.MOBILE AND tr.sc_ts=a.sc_ts
)
SELECT 'Install TRUM plan creation within 30 mins (OTP anchor)' AS kpi,
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-1",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-2",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-3",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-1",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-2",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-3",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-1",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-2",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-3"
FROM base CROSS JOIN params p;

name: Renewal Reminder - R0 (sent within 24h before expiry)
description: Of plan expiries where the customer hadn't already recharged early (or renewed with zero gap), what share had the R0 renewal reminder sent within 24 hours before expiry?
query:
-- CHANGE (this pass):
-- (1) r0_sends bridge now goes MESSAGE_HISTORY.MAPPED_USER_ID -> USERS.ID -> USERS.ACCOUNT_ID ->
-- T_WG_CUSTOMER.ACCOUNT_ID directly, instead of MAPPED_USER_ID -> USERS.MOBILE -> T_WG_CUSTOMER.MOBILE.
-- USERS.ACCOUNT_ID matches T_WG_CUSTOMER.ACCOUNT_ID (via TRY_TO_NUMBER) on 235,931/235,997 = 99.97%,
-- avoiding the mobile-string join entirely (a known weak point elsewhere -- e.g. _ARCHIVED-suffixed
-- mobiles in T_WG_CUSTOMER silently break plain MOBILE = MOBILE joins).
-- (2) denominator excludes customers who already recharged BEFORE their plan actually expired.
-- These never needed an R0 reminder in the first place -- a prior RCA on this exact metric found 99.1%
-- of "misses" were early self-renewers, not real reminder failures. Added via next_recharge: the very
-- next recharge on the same NAS after THIS specific plan's own start.
-- (3) denominator now ALSO excludes customers whose next recharge lands in the exact same second as
-- their plan's expiry (a seamless, zero-gap back-to-back renewal) -- these never had a real "at risk of
-- lapsing" window either. Verified effect: +0.02 to +0.15pp across D-1..M-3 after adding this exclusion.
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today),
test_partner_mobiles AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT MOBILE AS mobile FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING
  WHERE CREATED_BY IN (SELECT LCO_ACCOUNT_ID FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.TEST_LCO_ACCOUNT_ID)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT w.mobile FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w
  JOIN PROD_DB.CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE_CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE.CONNECTIONS c
  ON c.customer_id=w.account_id AND c._FIVETRAN_ACTIVE
  WHERE LOWER(c.CSP_ID) IN ('a0a0b1','a0a6w1')
),
expiry_events_raw AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    w.mobile, w.account_id, t.router_nas_id,
    DATEADD(minute,330,t.otp_issued_time)::timestamp_ntz AS plan_start_ts,
    DATEADD(minute,330,t.otp_expiry_time)::timestamp_ntz AS expiry_ts
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING t
  JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w ON t.router_nas_id = w.nasid
  WHERE t.otp='DONE' AND t.device_limit=10 AND t.store_group_id=0 AND t.mobile>'5999999999'
),
expiry_events_pretest AS (
  SELECT e.* FROM expiry_events_raw e
  LEFT JOIN test_partner_mobiles tp ON tp.mobile=e.mobile WHERE tp.mobile IS NULL
),
next_recharge AS (
  SELECT e.mobile, e.router_nas_id, e.plan_start_ts, e.expiry_ts,
    MIN(DATEADD(minute,330,t2.otp_issued_time)::timestamp_ntz) AS next_recharge_ts
  FROM expiry_events_pretest e
  JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING t2
    ON t2.router_nas_id = e.router_nas_id
    AND t2.otp = 'DONE'
    AND DATEADD(minute,330,t2.otp_issued_time) > e.plan_start_ts
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
),
expiry_events AS (
  SELECT e.*
  FROM expiry_events_pretest e
  LEFT JOIN next_recharge nr
    ON nr.mobile=e.mobile AND nr.router_nas_id=e.router_nas_id AND nr.plan_start_ts=e.plan_start_ts
  WHERE nr.next_recharge_ts IS NULL
     OR (nr.next_recharge_ts > e.expiry_ts AND DATEDIFF('second', e.expiry_ts, nr.next_recharge_ts) != 0)
),
r0_sends AS (
  SELECT u.ACCOUNT_ID AS account_id, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', mh.CREATED_AT)::timestamp_ntz AS sent_at
  FROM PROD_DB.MESSAGE_ORCHESTRATOR_SERVICE_AUDIT_PUBLIC.MESSAGE_HISTORY mh
  JOIN PROD_DB.MESSAGE_ORCHESTRATOR_SERVICE_AUDIT_PUBLIC.MESSAGE_TEMPLATE mt
    ON mt.ID = mh.TEMPLATE_ID AND mt._FIVETRAN_ACTIVE = TRUE
  JOIN PROD_DB.MESSAGE_ORCHESTRATOR_SERVICE_AUDIT_PUBLIC.USERS u ON u.ID = mh.MAPPED_USER_ID
  WHERE mt.TEMPLATE_CODE ILIKE 'renewal_r0_expired%'
    AND u.ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL
),
matched AS (
  SELECT e.mobile, e.expiry_ts, MIN(DATEDIFF('minute', s.sent_at, e.expiry_ts)) AS gap_min
  FROM expiry_events e
  JOIN r0_sends s
    ON TRY_TO_NUMBER(s.account_id) = e.account_id
    AND s.sent_at <= e.expiry_ts AND s.sent_at >= DATEADD(hour,-24, e.expiry_ts)
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
base AS (
  SELECT DATE(e.expiry_ts) AS d, 1 AS den,
    CASE WHEN m.mobile IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS num
  FROM expiry_events e LEFT JOIN matched m ON m.mobile=e.mobile AND m.expiry_ts=e.expiry_ts
)

 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-1",

 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-3",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-1",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-2",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-3",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-1",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-2",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-3"
FROM base CROSS JOIN params p;

name: Recharge to device live within 2h (non-queued only)
description: Of recharges that follow a genuine offline period (paid >=15 min after the prior plan's expiry, or the first-ever plan on that device), what share had the device show ping activity within 2 hours? Excludes queued recharges (paid before the prior plan expired), since those never take the router offline and don't test recovery behaviour.
query:
-- CHANGE (this pass): (1) added non-queued filter -- a recharge paid before the
-- previous plan expired just queues; the router never goes offline, so it doesn't
-- test recovery behaviour. New CTE recharges_with_prev computes each NAS ID's
-- previous plan expiry (LAG), and recharges now keeps only rows where the current
-- plan starts >=15 min after that expiry (or there was no previous plan at all).
-- (2) Extended the scan bound from a fixed day count to a dynamic one based on the
-- start of last month, and widened recharges_raw's lookback to 100 days so the LAG
-- can always see the prior plan -- needed once W-1..M-3 (not just D-1..D-3) are
-- back in scope. All 9 output columns and the 45-day ping-retention NULL-blanking
-- logic are unchanged from the original query.
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today),
test_partner_mobiles AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT MOBILE AS mobile FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING
 WHERE CREATED_BY IN (SELECT LCO_ACCOUNT_ID FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.TEST_LCO_ACCOUNT_ID)
 UNION
 SELECT DISTINCT w.mobile FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w
 JOIN PROD_DB.CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE_CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE.CONNECTIONS c
 ON c.customer_id=w.account_id AND c._FIVETRAN_ACTIVE
 WHERE LOWER(c.CSP_ID) IN ('a0a0b1','a0a6w1')
),
recharges_raw AS (
 SELECT w.mobile, w.nasid,
  DATEADD(minute,330,t.otp_issued_time)::timestamp_ntz recharge_ts,
  DATEADD(minute,330,t.otp_expiry_time)::timestamp_ntz expiry_ts
 FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING t
 JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w ON t.router_nas_id = w.nasid
 WHERE t.otp='DONE' AND t.device_limit=10 AND t.store_group_id=0 AND t.mobile>'5999999999'
  AND t.otp_issued_time >= DATEADD(day,-100,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
),
recharges_with_prev AS (
 SELECT *, LAG(expiry_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY nasid ORDER BY recharge_ts) AS prev_expiry_ts
 FROM recharges_raw
),
recharges AS (
 SELECT r.nasid, r.recharge_ts FROM recharges_with_prev r
 LEFT JOIN test_partner_mobiles tp ON tp.mobile=r.mobile
 WHERE tp.mobile IS NULL
 AND r.recharge_ts >= DATE_TRUNC('month', DATEADD('month',-1,(SELECT today FROM params)))
 AND (r.prev_expiry_ts IS NULL OR r.recharge_ts >= DATEADD(minute,15,r.prev_expiry_ts))
),
ping_ok AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT r.nasid, r.recharge_ts
 FROM recharges r
 JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.HOURLY_DEVICE_PING_INFLUX p ON TO_VARCHAR(p.nas_id)=TO_VARCHAR(r.nasid)
 WHERE p.total_pings_received>0
 AND p.first_ping_ts_ist <= DATEADD(hour,2,r.recharge_ts) AND p.last_ping_ts_ist >= r.recharge_ts
),
base AS (
 SELECT DATE(r.recharge_ts) AS d, 1 AS den,
 CASE WHEN po.nasid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS num
 FROM recharges r LEFT JOIN ping_ok po ON po.nasid=r.nasid AND po.recharge_ts=r.recharge_ts
)
SELECT 'Recharge to device live within 2h (non-queued only)' AS kpi,
 CASE WHEN (MAX(p.today)-1) >= (DATEADD(day,-45,MAX(p.today))) THEN 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN den END),0)*100 ELSE NULL END AS "D-1",
 CASE WHEN (MAX(p.today)-2) >= (DATEADD(day,-45,MAX(p.today))) THEN 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN den END),0)*100 ELSE NULL END AS "D-2",
 CASE WHEN (MAX(p.today)-3) >= (DATEADD(day,-45,MAX(p.today))) THEN 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN den END),0)*100 ELSE NULL END AS "D-3",
 CASE WHEN (DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',MAX(p.today)))) >= (DATEADD(day,-45,MAX(p.today))) THEN 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 ELSE NULL END AS "W-1",
 CASE WHEN (DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',MAX(p.today)))) >= (DATEADD(day,-45,MAX(p.today))) THEN 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 ELSE NULL END AS "W-2",
 CASE WHEN (DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',MAX(p.today)))) >= (DATEADD(day,-45,MAX(p.today))) THEN 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 ELSE NULL END AS "W-3",
 CASE WHEN (DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',MAX(p.today)))) >= (DATEADD(day,-45,MAX(p.today))) THEN 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 ELSE NULL END AS "M-1",
 CASE WHEN (DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',MAX(p.today)))) >= (DATEADD(day,-45,MAX(p.today))) THEN 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 ELSE NULL END AS "M-2",
 CASE WHEN (DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',MAX(p.today)))) >= (DATEADD(day,-45,MAX(p.today))) THEN 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 ELSE NULL END AS "M-3"
FROM base CROSS JOIN params p;

name: Renewal provisioning (payment -> plan & entitlement)
description: Of successful renewal payments, what share had a matching plan and entitlement created against that same transaction?
query:
WITH clock AS (
    SELECT
        TO_DATE(
            CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
        ) AS as_of_date
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT
        as_of_date,
        DATEADD(
            'day',
            1 - DAYOFWEEKISO(as_of_date),
            as_of_date
        )::DATE AS current_week_monday,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', as_of_date)::DATE AS current_month_start
    FROM
        clock
),
periods AS (
    /* Previous completed days */
    SELECT
        'D-1' AS period_label,
        DATEADD('day', -1, as_of_date)::DATE AS start_date,
        as_of_date::DATE AS end_date_exclusive
    FROM
        bounds
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'D-2',
        DATEADD('day', -2, as_of_date)::DATE,
        DATEADD('day', -1, as_of_date)::DATE
    FROM
        bounds
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'D-3',
        DATEADD('day', -3, as_of_date)::DATE,
        DATEADD('day', -2, as_of_date)::DATE
    FROM
        bounds
        /* Previous completed Monday-Sunday weeks */
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'W-1',
        DATEADD('day', -7, current_week_monday)::DATE,
        current_week_monday::DATE
    FROM
        bounds
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'W-2',
        DATEADD('day', -14, current_week_monday)::DATE,
        DATEADD('day', -7, current_week_monday)::DATE
    FROM
        bounds
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'W-3',
        DATEADD('day', -21, current_week_monday)::DATE,
        DATEADD('day', -14, current_week_monday)::DATE
    FROM
        bounds
        /* Previous completed calendar months */
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'M-1',
        DATEADD('month', -1, current_month_start)::DATE,
        current_month_start::DATE
    FROM
        bounds
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'M-2',
        DATEADD('month', -2, current_month_start)::DATE,
        DATEADD('month', -1, current_month_start)::DATE
    FROM
        bounds
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'M-3',
        DATEADD('month', -3, current_month_start)::DATE,
        DATEADD('month', -2, current_month_start)::DATE
    FROM
        bounds
),
source_window AS (
    SELECT
        MIN(start_date)::DATE AS start_date,
        MAX(end_date_exclusive)::DATE AS end_date_exclusive
    FROM
        periods
),
renewal_pmt AS (
    SELECT
        w.transaction_id,
        RIGHT(w.mobile, 10) AS mobile10,
        CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
            'Asia/Kolkata',
            w.create_date
        ) AS pay_time_ist,
        CASE
            WHEN ARRAY_SIZE(SPLIT(w.transaction_id, '_')) > 4 THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(
                w.transaction_id,
                '_[0-9]+$',
                ''
            )
            ELSE w.transaction_id
        END AS grp_txn_id
    FROM
        prod_db.dynamodb_read.wiom_billing_wifi w
    WHERE
        w._fivetran_active = TRUE
        AND w.payment_status = 1
        AND (
            LOWER(SPLIT_PART(w.transaction_id, '_', 1)) IN (
                'custgen',
                'custwgsubs',
                'cussubs',
                'wgsubs',
                'wgmand'
            )
            OR LOWER(w.source) IN (
                'custgen',
                'custwgsubs',
                'cussubs',
                'wgsubs',
                'wgmand'
            )
        )
        AND LOWER(w.source) NOT IN ('w', 'wiomwall')
        AND LOWER(
            SPLIT_PART(w.transaction_id, '_', 1)
        ) NOT IN ('m', 'mr')
        AND w.transaction_id NOT ILIKE '%cxteamlink%'
        AND w.transaction_id NOT IN (
            SELECT
                booking_payment_txn_id
            FROM
                prod_db.dynamodb_read.booking
            WHERE
                booking_payment_txn_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION
            SELECT
                rebooking_payment_txn_id
            FROM
                prod_db.dynamodb_read.booking
            WHERE
                rebooking_payment_txn_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION
            SELECT
                sd_txn_id
            FROM
                prod_db.dynamodb_read.booking
            WHERE
                sd_txn_id IS NOT NULL
        )
        AND w.transaction_id NOT IN (
            SELECT
                booking_txn_id
            FROM
                prod_db.dynamodb_read.customer_v_2
            WHERE
                booking_txn_id IS NOT NULL
            UNION
            SELECT
                sd_txn_id
            FROM
                prod_db.dynamodb_read.customer_v_2
            WHERE
                sd_txn_id IS NOT NULL
        )
        AND DATE(
            CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
                'Asia/Kolkata',
                w.create_date
            )
        ) >= '2026-07-01'
        AND DATE(
            CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
                'Asia/Kolkata',
                w.create_date
            )
        ) >= (
            SELECT
                start_date
            FROM
                source_window
        )
        AND DATE(
            CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
                'Asia/Kolkata',
                w.create_date
            )
        ) < (
            SELECT
                end_date_exclusive
            FROM
                source_window
        )
),
conn AS (
    SELECT
        DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM
        prod_db.csp_connection_lifecycle_service_csp_connection_lifecycle_service.connections
    WHERE
        customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
migrated_mobiles AS (
    SELECT
        DISTINCT RIGHT(t.mobile, 10) AS mobile10
    FROM
        prod_db.public.t_wg_customer t
        JOIN conn c ON c.customer_id = t.account_id::VARCHAR
    WHERE
        t.mobile IS NOT NULL
        AND t.account_id IS NOT NULL
),
refunded_txn AS (
    SELECT
        DISTINCT transaction_id
    FROM
        prod_db.dynamodb_read.wiom_billing_wifi
    WHERE
        refund_status = 1
        AND update_date >= (
            SELECT
                start_date
            FROM
                source_window
        )
),
plans AS (
    SELECT
        transaction_id,
        MIN(
            CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
                'UTC',
                'Asia/Kolkata',
                created_on
            )
        ) AS plan_time_ist
    FROM
        prod_db.public.t_router_user_mapping
    WHERE
        otp = 'DONE'
        AND device_limit = 10 and created_by not in (select lco_account_id from test_lco_account_id)
        AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL
        AND created_on >= (
            SELECT
                start_date
            FROM
                source_window
        )
    GROUP BY
        transaction_id
),
ent AS (
    SELECT
        payment_reference_id AS transaction_id,
        entitlement_start,
        entitlement_end,
        superseded,
        CONVERT_TIMEZONE(
            'Asia/Kolkata',
            created_at
        ) AS ent_created_ist
    FROM
        prod_db.csp_crv_service_csp_crv_service.scheduled_expiries
    WHERE
        payment_reference_id IS NOT NULL
        AND created_at >= (
            SELECT
                start_date
            FROM
                source_window
        ) QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY payment_reference_id
            ORDER BY
                _fivetran_start DESC
        ) = 1
),
grp AS (
    SELECT
        rp.grp_txn_id,
        MIN(rp.mobile10) AS mobile,
        COUNT(*) AS member_txn_count,
        MIN(rp.pay_time_ist) AS pay_time_ist,
        DATE(MIN(rp.pay_time_ist)) AS payment_date,
        MAX(
            IFF(mm.mobile10 IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)
        ) AS is_migrated,
        MAX(
            IFF(rx.transaction_id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)
        ) AS is_refunded,
        MAX(
            IFF(pl.transaction_id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)
        ) AS has_plan,
        MAX(
            IFF(en.transaction_id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)
        ) AS has_ent,
        MIN(pl.plan_time_ist) AS plan_time_ist,
        MIN(en.ent_created_ist) AS ent_created_ist,
        MAX(en.superseded) AS superseded,
        MAX(en.entitlement_end) AS entitlement_end
    FROM
        renewal_pmt rp
        LEFT JOIN migrated_mobiles mm ON mm.mobile10 = rp.mobile10
        LEFT JOIN refunded_txn rx ON rx.transaction_id = rp.transaction_id
        LEFT JOIN plans pl ON pl.transaction_id = rp.transaction_id
        LEFT JOIN ent en ON en.transaction_id = rp.transaction_id
    GROUP BY
        rp.grp_txn_id
),
period_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.period_label,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * SUM(
                IFF(
                    g.is_migrated = 1
                    AND g.is_refunded = 0
                    AND g.has_plan = 1
                    AND g.has_ent = 1,
                    1,
                    0
                )
            ) / NULLIF(
                SUM(
                    IFF(
                        g.is_migrated = 1
                        AND g.is_refunded = 0,
                        1,
                        0
                    )
                ),
                0
            ),
            2
        ) AS metric_value
    FROM
        periods p
        LEFT JOIN grp g ON g.payment_date >= p.start_date
        AND g.payment_date < p.end_date_exclusive
    GROUP BY
        p.period_label
)
SELECT
    'Renewal provisioning (payment -> plan & entitlement)' AS "KPI",
    COALESCE(
        TO_VARCHAR(
            MAX(IFF(period_label = 'D-1', metric_value, NULL))
        ),
        '-'
    ) AS "D-1",
    COALESCE(
        TO_VARCHAR(
            MAX(IFF(period_label = 'D-2', metric_value, NULL))
        ),
        '-'
    ) AS "D-2",
    COALESCE(
        TO_VARCHAR(
            MAX(IFF(period_label = 'D-3', metric_value, NULL))
        ),
        '-'
    ) AS "D-3",
    COALESCE(
        TO_VARCHAR(
            MAX(IFF(period_label = 'W-1', metric_value, NULL))
        ),
        '-'
    ) AS "W-1",
    COALESCE(
        TO_VARCHAR(
            MAX(IFF(period_label = 'W-2', metric_value, NULL))
        ),
        '-'
    ) AS "W-2",
    COALESCE(
        TO_VARCHAR(
            MAX(IFF(period_label = 'W-3', metric_value, NULL))
        ),
        '-'
    ) AS "W-3",
    COALESCE(
        TO_VARCHAR(
            MAX(IFF(period_label = 'M-1', metric_value, NULL))
        ),
        '-'
    ) AS "M-1",
    COALESCE(
        TO_VARCHAR(
            MAX(IFF(period_label = 'M-2', metric_value, NULL))
        ),
        '-'
    ) AS "M-2",
    COALESCE(
        TO_VARCHAR(
            MAX(IFF(period_label = 'M-3', metric_value, NULL))
        ),
        '-'
    ) AS "M-3"
FROM
    period_metrics;

name: Customer plan ISP coverage (paid-hour level)
description: Of every hour a customer's plan is active and paid for, what share actually had ISP access enabled (gate open)?
query:
-- CHANGE (this pass): (1) added test-partner exclusion to the home/plans cohort (previously none).
 -- (2) fixed hours grid: was GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT=>2400) = 100 days back from today, but M-3 (a full
 -- calendar month starting 3 months back) can start up to ~122-123 days before today depending on
 -- month lengths -- the old 100-day grid silently truncated M-3 (and sometimes M-2) most months.
 -- Bumped to GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT=>3360) = 140 days, comfortable margin over the ~123-day worst case.
 -- (3) blanked columns RECHARGE_GATES can't cover: this table only has data from 2026-06-20 onward,
 -- so any window whose start predates that (confirmed this pass: was showing falsely-low
 -- percentages for M-2/M-3, e.g. 35% and 7.7%, not real coverage gaps) now shows NULL instead.
 WITH params AS (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today),
 test_partner_mobiles AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT MOBILE AS mobile FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING
  WHERE CREATED_BY IN (SELECT LCO_ACCOUNT_ID FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.TEST_LCO_ACCOUNT_ID)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT w.mobile FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w
  JOIN PROD_DB.CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE_CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE.CONNECTIONS c
  ON c.customer_id=w.account_id AND c._FIVETRAN_ACTIVE
  WHERE LOWER(c.CSP_ID) IN ('a0a0b1','a0a6w1')
 ),
 excluded_pnm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nasid FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_DEVICE WHERE device_id ILIKE 'pnm%' AND nasid IS NOT NULL
 ),
 home AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.connection_id, w.nasid
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING t JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w ON t.router_nas_id=w.nasid
  JOIN PROD_DB.CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE_CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE.CONNECTIONS c
  ON c.customer_id=w.account_id AND c._FIVETRAN_ACTIVE
  LEFT JOIN test_partner_mobiles tp ON tp.mobile=w.mobile
  WHERE t.otp='DONE' AND t.device_limit=10 AND t.store_group_id=0 AND t.mobile>'5999999999'
  AND t.router_nas_id NOT IN (SELECT nasid FROM excluded_pnm)
  AND tp.mobile IS NULL
 ),
 hours AS (
  SELECT DATEADD(hour, seq, DATEADD(day,-140,(SELECT today FROM params))::timestamp_ntz) hstart
  FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SEQ4())-1 seq FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT=>3360)))
 ),
 plans AS (
  SELECT w.nasid, w.mobile, DATEADD(minute,330,t.otp_issued_time)::timestamp_ntz ps_ts,
  DATEADD(minute,330,t.otp_expiry_time)::timestamp_ntz pe_ts
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING t JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w ON t.router_nas_id=w.nasid
  WHERE t.otp='DONE' AND t.device_limit=10 AND t.store_group_id=0 AND t.mobile>'5999999999'
 ),
 gates AS (
  SELECT g.connection_id, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata',g.window_start)::timestamp_ntz ws_ts,
  CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata',g.window_end)::timestamp_ntz we_ts
  FROM PROD_DB.CSP_RV_SERVICE_CSP_RV_SERVICE.RECHARGE_GATES g WHERE g._FIVETRAN_ACTIVE
 ),
 paid_hours AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT h.hstart, hm.connection_id
  FROM plans p JOIN home hm ON hm.nasid=p.nasid JOIN hours h ON p.ps_ts<=h.hstart AND p.pe_ts>h.hstart
 ),
 isp_hours AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT h.hstart, g.connection_id
  FROM gates g JOIN hours h ON g.ws_ts<=h.hstart AND g.we_ts>h.hstart
 ),
 base AS (
  SELECT DATE(ph.hstart) d, 1 den,
  CASE WHEN ih.connection_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END num
  FROM paid_hours ph LEFT JOIN isp_hours ih ON ih.connection_id=ph.connection_id AND ih.hstart=ph.hstart
 )

name: Captive Portal triggered -> Captive portal open
description: Of times the captive portal was triggered (captive_portal_initialised event), what share had the portal actually open (open_captive_portal event) on the customer's device?
query:
-- CHANGE (this pass): (1) added test-partner exclusion via NAS_ID -> T_WG_CUSTOMER.nasid -> mobile
 -- (previously this KPI had NO customer/partner link at all, so no exclusion was possible).
 -- (2) fixed flawed matching: the old join matched a trigger to the NEAREST open for that NAS_ID
 -- within 5 min with no session boundary, so if a device fired multiple triggers close together
 -- (reconnects etc.) an open event could get credited to the wrong trigger. Now bounds each
 -- trigger's candidate opens to before the NEXT trigger for that same NAS_ID (LEAD window),
 -- so an open can only match the trigger that immediately preceded it.
 WITH params AS (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today),
 test_partner_nasids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.nasid FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w
  JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING t ON t.router_nas_id = w.nasid
  WHERE t.created_by IN (SELECT LCO_ACCOUNT_ID FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.TEST_LCO_ACCOUNT_ID)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT w.nasid FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w
  JOIN PROD_DB.CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE_CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE.CONNECTIONS c
  ON c.customer_id=w.account_id AND c._FIVETRAN_ACTIVE
  WHERE LOWER(c.CSP_ID) IN ('a0a0b1','a0a6w1')
 ),
 triggers_raw AS (
  SELECT NAS_ID, ADDED_TIME trig_ts FROM PROD_DB.CUSTOMER_CAPTIVE_PORTAL_EVENTS_PUBLIC.EVENT_INGESTION_LOG
  WHERE EVENT_NAME='captive_portal_initialised' AND ADDED_TIME BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'
 ),
 triggers AS (
  SELECT t.* FROM triggers_raw t
  LEFT JOIN test_partner_nasids tp ON tp.nasid=t.NAS_ID WHERE tp.nasid IS NULL
 ),
 triggers_bounded AS (
  SELECT NAS_ID, trig_ts,
  LEAD(trig_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY NAS_ID ORDER BY trig_ts) next_trig_ts
  FROM triggers
 ),
 opens AS (
  SELECT NAS_ID, ADDED_TIME open_ts FROM PROD_DB.CUSTOMER_CAPTIVE_PORTAL_EVENTS_PUBLIC.EVENT_INGESTION_LOG
  WHERE EVENT_NAME='open_captive_portal' AND ADDED_TIME BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31'
 ),
 matched AS (
  SELECT t.NAS_ID, t.trig_ts, MIN(ABS(DATEDIFF('minute', o.open_ts, t.trig_ts))) gap_min
  FROM triggers_bounded t
  JOIN opens o ON o.NAS_ID=t.NAS_ID AND ABS(DATEDIFF('minute', o.open_ts, t.trig_ts))<=5
  AND o.open_ts >= t.trig_ts AND (t.next_trig_ts IS NULL OR o.open_ts < t.next_trig_ts)
  GROUP BY 1,2
 ),
 base AS (
  SELECT DATE(t.trig_ts) d, 1 den, CASE WHEN m.gap_min IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END num
  FROM triggers t LEFT JOIN matched m ON m.NAS_ID=t.NAS_ID AND m.trig_ts=t.trig_ts
 )
 SELECT 'Captive Portal triggered -> open' AS kpi,
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-1",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-2",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-3",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-1",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-2",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-3",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-1",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-2",
  1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-3"
 FROM base CROSS JOIN params p;

name: Recharge Ticket Creation Rate (System Health)

query:
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today),
test_partner_mobiles AS (

  ON c.customer_id=w.account_id AND c._FIVETRAN_ACTIVE
  WHERE LOWER(c.CSP_ID) IN ('a0a0b1','a0a6w1')
),
excluded_pnm AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nasid FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_DEVICE WHERE device_id ILIKE 'pnm%' AND nasid IS NOT NULL
),
home AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.connection_id, w.nasid, w.mobile
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING t JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER w ON t.router_nas_id=w.nasid
  JOIN PROD_DB.CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE_CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE.CONNECTIONS c

  AND t.router_nas_id NOT IN (SELECT nasid FROM excluded_pnm)
  AND tp.mobile IS NULL
),
install_dates AS (
  SELECT router_nas_id AS nasid, MIN(DATEADD(minute,330, otp_issued_time)::timestamp_ntz) AS install_ts
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING
  WHERE otp='DONE' AND device_limit=10 AND store_group_id=0 AND mobile>'5999999999'
  GROUP BY router_nas_id
),
trum_segments AS (
  SELECT t.router_nas_id AS nasid,
    DATEADD(minute,330, t.otp_issued_time)::timestamp_ntz ps_ts,
    DATEADD(minute,330, t.otp_expiry_time)::timestamp_ntz pe_ts
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING t
  WHERE t.otp='DONE' AND t.device_limit=10 AND t.store_group_id=0 AND t.mobile>'5999999999'
    AND DATEADD(minute,330, t.otp_issued_time)::timestamp_ntz < (SELECT today FROM params)::timestamp_ntz
    AND DATEADD(minute,330, t.otp_expiry_time)::timestamp_ntz > DATEADD(day,-3,(SELECT today FROM params))::timestamp_ntz
),
hours AS (
  SELECT DATEADD(hour, seq, DATEADD(day,-3,(SELECT today FROM params))::timestamp_ntz) hstart
  FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SEQ4())-1 seq FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT=>72)))
),
paid_hours AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT h.hstart, hm.connection_id
  FROM trum_segments s
  JOIN home hm ON hm.nasid = s.nasid
  JOIN install_dates idt ON idt.nasid = s.nasid
  JOIN hours h ON s.ps_ts <= h.hstart AND s.pe_ts > h.hstart

tickets AS (

ticket_hours AS (

  FROM tickets tk JOIN hours h ON tk.created_ts <= h.hstart AND tk.obligation_end_ts > h.hstart

base AS (

)
SELECT 'Recharge Ticket Creation Rate (System Health)' AS kpi,
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-1",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-2",

FROM base CROSS JOIN params p;

name: % Refund Requested (PAYG)

query:
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today),
 nb AS (
 SELECT EXECUTION_CANDIDATE_ID, LAST_CONNECTION_ID, STATE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, CSP_ID
 FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.NBREC_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES
 WHERE _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE = TRUE -- fan-out bug otherwise: history table, not current-state-only
 ),
 conn AS (
 SELECT CONNECTION_ID, CUSTOMER_ID FROM PROD_DB.CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE_CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE.CONNECTIONS
 WHERE _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE = TRUE
 ),
 nb_cust AS (
 SELECT nb.EXECUTION_CANDIDATE_ID, nb.STATE, nb.CREATED_AT, nb.UPDATED_AT, nb.CSP_ID, TRY_TO_NUMBER(conn.CUSTOMER_ID) AS CUSTOMER_ID
 FROM nb JOIN conn ON nb.LAST_CONNECTION_ID = conn.CONNECTION_ID
 ),
 test_csp_customers AS ( -- hardcoded test/QA CSP partners, excluded below
 SELECT DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID FROM nb_cust WHERE LOWER(CSP_ID) IN ('a0a0b1','a0a6w1') AND CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL
 ),
 cust_nas AS (SELECT ACCOUNT_ID, NASID FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER where lco_account_id not in (SELECT DISTINCT LCO_ACCOUNT_ID FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.TEST_LCO_ACCOUNT_ID WHERE LCO_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL) and mobile>'5999999999'),
 last_plan AS ( -- last plan whose SELECTED_PLAN_ID actually resolves (inner join drops 0/junk-epoch rows)
 SELECT t.ROUTER_NAS_ID, pc.COMBINED_SETTING_ID,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.ROUTER_NAS_ID ORDER BY t.CREATED_ON DESC) rn
 FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING t
 JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_PLAN_CONFIGURATION pc ON t.SELECTED_PLAN_ID = pc.ID where t.created_by not in (SELECT DISTINCT LCO_ACCOUNT_ID FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.TEST_LCO_ACCOUNT_ID WHERE LCO_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL) and mobile>'5999999999' and device_limit=10 and otp='DONE'
 ),
 payg_nas AS (SELECT ROUTER_NAS_ID FROM last_plan WHERE rn=1 AND COMBINED_SETTING_ID=22), -- migrated or installed, PAYG last plan only
 tickets_payg AS (
 SELECT nc.EXECUTION_CANDIDATE_ID, nc.STATE, nc.CREATED_AT, nc.UPDATED_AT, nc.CUSTOMER_ID
 FROM nb_cust nc
 JOIN cust_nas cn ON nc.CUSTOMER_ID = cn.ACCOUNT_ID

 WHERE nc.CUSTOMER_ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM test_csp_customers)
 ),

name: Refund Orders stuck 5+ days in Processing (PAYG)
description: How many PAYG refund orders are currently in PROCESSING status and have already been there 5+ days? Shown as a count, not a percentage -- target is zero.
query:
WITH nb AS (
 SELECT LAST_CONNECTION_ID, CSP_ID FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.NBREC_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES
 WHERE _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE = TRUE
 ),
 conn AS (
 SELECT CONNECTION_ID, CUSTOMER_ID FROM PROD_DB.CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE_CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE.CONNECTIONS
 WHERE _FIVETRAN_ACTIVE = TRUE
 ),
 nb_cust AS (
 SELECT nb.CSP_ID, TRY_TO_NUMBER(conn.CUSTOMER_ID) AS CUSTOMER_ID
 FROM nb JOIN conn ON nb.LAST_CONNECTION_ID = conn.CONNECTION_ID
 ),
 test_csp_customers AS ( -- hardcoded test/QA CSP partners, excluded below
 SELECT DISTINCT CUSTOMER_ID FROM nb_cust WHERE LOWER(CSP_ID) IN ('a0a0b1','a0a6w1') AND CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL
 ),
 cust_nas AS (SELECT ACCOUNT_ID, NASID FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_WG_CUSTOMER where lco_account_id not in (SELECT DISTINCT LCO_ACCOUNT_ID FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.TEST_LCO_ACCOUNT_ID WHERE LCO_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL) and mobile>'5999999999'),
 last_plan AS ( -- last plan whose SELECTED_PLAN_ID actually resolves (inner join drops 0/junk-epoch rows)
 SELECT t.ROUTER_NAS_ID, pc.COMBINED_SETTING_ID,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.ROUTER_NAS_ID ORDER BY t.CREATED_ON DESC) rn
 FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_ROUTER_USER_MAPPING t
 JOIN PROD_DB.PUBLIC.T_PLAN_CONFIGURATION pc ON t.SELECTED_PLAN_ID = pc.ID where t.created_by not in (SELECT DISTINCT LCO_ACCOUNT_ID FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.TEST_LCO_ACCOUNT_ID WHERE LCO_ACCOUNT_ID IS NOT NULL) and mobile>'5999999999' and device_limit=10 and otp='DONE'
 ),
 payg_nas AS (SELECT ROUTER_NAS_ID FROM last_plan WHERE rn=1 AND COMBINED_SETTING_ID=22), -- migrated or installed, PAYG last plan only
 payg_customers AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT cn.ACCOUNT_ID
 FROM cust_nas cn JOIN payg_nas pn ON cn.NASID = pn.ROUTER_NAS_ID
 ),
 history AS ( -- full status history (SCD), used to reconstruct "status as of a past point in time"
 SELECT ID, CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID, STATUS, UPDATED_AT, _FIVETRAN_START
 FROM PROD_DB.CUSTOMER_DB_CUSTOMER_PROFILE_SERVICE_AUDIT_PUBLIC.SECURITY_DEPOSIT_ORDERS
 ),
 snapshots AS ( -- one row per lookback day: D-1, D-2, D-3 -> IST midnight boundary marking end of that day
 SELECT n,
 TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(TO_VARCHAR(DATEADD('day', -n+1, DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())))) || ' 00:00:00 +05:30') AS boundary_ts
 FROM (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3)
 ),
 status_as_of AS ( -- most recent status version that existed at/before each snapshot boundary
 SELECT s.n, s.boundary_ts, h.ID, h.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID, h.STATUS,
 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.n, h.ID ORDER BY h._FIVETRAN_START DESC) rn
 FROM history h
 JOIN snapshots s ON h._FIVETRAN_START <= s.boundary_ts
 ),
 entered_processing_asof AS ( -- first time each order entered PROCESSING, known as of that snapshot
 SELECT s.n, h.ID, MIN(h.UPDATED_AT) AS entered_processing_at
 FROM history h
 JOIN snapshots s ON h._FIVETRAN_START <= s.boundary_ts
 WHERE h.STATUS = 'PROCESSING'
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ),
 stuck AS ( -- PAYG orders that were CURRENTLY sitting in PROCESSING as of each snapshot, and had already been there >=5 days
 SELECT sa.n,
 SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF('hour', ep.entered_processing_at, sa.boundary_ts)/24.0 >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stuck_count
 FROM status_as_of sa
 JOIN entered_processing_asof ep ON sa.n = ep.n AND sa.ID = ep.ID
 WHERE sa.rn = 1 AND sa.STATUS = 'PROCESSING'
 AND sa.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID NOT IN (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID FROM test_csp_customers)
 AND sa.CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID IN (SELECT ACCOUNT_ID FROM payg_customers)
 GROUP BY sa.n
 )
SELECT 'Refund Orders stuck 5+ days in Processing (PAYG)' AS kpi,
 MAX(CASE WHEN n=1 THEN stuck_count END) AS "D-1",
 MAX(CASE WHEN n=2 THEN stuck_count END) AS "D-2",
 MAX(CASE WHEN n=3 THEN stuck_count END) AS "D-3",
 NULL AS "W-1", NULL AS "W-2", NULL AS "W-3",
 NULL AS "M-1", NULL AS "M-2", NULL AS "M-3"
FROM stuck;

name: Chat input to output within 1 min
description: Of customer chat messages, what share receive one within 60 seconds, excluding messages that are never meant to get a reply?
query:
WITH params AS (SELECT DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today),
excluded_pairs AS ( -- the 10 STATE x INTENT pairs that DO get a reply (everything else with these intents hits do_not_respond)
 SELECT * FROM VALUES
  ('ADDRESS_SUBMISSION_PENDING','confirmSlot'),
  ('SSID_SUBMISSION_PENDING','confirmSlot'),
  ('LATLONG_SUBMISSION_PENDING','confirmSlot'),
  ('SLOT_PROPOSED_CUSTOMER_CONFIRM_PENDING','confirmSlot'),
  ('RATING','confirmSlot'),
  ('ZERO_PARTNER_INTEREST','acknowledgement'),
  ('NO_ACTIVE_INTEREST','acknowledgement'),
  ('ALL_DECLINE_CYCLE_1','acknowledgement'),
  ('CX_CONFIRMED_BUT_SLOT_BREACHED','acknowledgement'),
  ('ROHIT_ASSIGNED_BUT_SLOT_BREACHED','acknowledgement')
 AS t(state_, intent_)
),
mh AS ( -- CHANGE (2026-08-03): now carries MAPPED_USER_ID (acct_id) alongside USER_ID.
 -- MESSAGE_HISTORY.CREATED_AT is a genuine TIMESTAMP_TZ, no shift needed.
 SELECT MAPPED_USER_ID AS acct_id, USER_ID, SENDER, CONVERT_TIMEZONE('Asia/Kolkata', CREATED_AT) AS ts_ist
 FROM PROD_DB.MESSAGE_ORCHESTRATOR_SERVICE_PUBLIC.MESSAGE_HISTORY
 WHERE MAPPED_USER_ID IS NOT NULL
 AND CREATED_AT >= DATEADD('day',-135, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
),
inbound AS ( -- SENDER must be exactly 'user' -- 'CUSTOMER' is a different, non-message event-log tag (verified)
 -- CHANGE: keep inbound_mobile (USER_ID) around -- needed later for the intent-classification join,
 -- since INTENT_CLASSIFICATIONS is keyed by mobile, not by acct_id.
 SELECT acct_id, USER_ID AS inbound_mobile, ts_ist AS inbound_ts FROM mh WHERE SENDER='user'
),
next_inbound AS ( -- CHANGE: self-join now keyed on acct_id instead of USER_ID/mobile (see note below query)
 SELECT i.acct_id, i.inbound_mobile, i.inbound_ts, MIN(i2.inbound_ts) AS next_inbound_ts
 FROM inbound i
 LEFT JOIN inbound i2 ON i2.acct_id = i.acct_id AND i2.inbound_ts > i.inbound_ts
 GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
bounded AS ( -- a reply only counts if it lands before the customer's OWN next message (or 24h), else it's an unrelated later reply
 SELECT acct_id, inbound_mobile, inbound_ts,
  LEAST(COALESCE(next_inbound_ts, DATEADD('hour',24,inbound_ts)), DATEADD('hour',24,inbound_ts)) AS bound_ts
 FROM next_inbound
),
outbound AS ( -- CHANGE: keyed on acct_id instead of USER_ID/mobile
 SELECT acct_id, ts_ist AS outbound_ts FROM mh WHERE SENDER='SYSTEM'
),
matched_reply AS ( -- CHANGE: reply match now on acct_id -- this is the actual fix, see note below query
 SELECT b.acct_id, b.inbound_mobile, b.inbound_ts, MIN(o.outbound_ts) AS reply_ts
 FROM bounded b
 LEFT JOIN outbound o ON o.acct_id = b.acct_id AND o.outbound_ts >= b.inbound_ts AND o.outbound_ts < b.bound_ts
 GROUP BY 1,2,3
),
ic AS ( -- INTENT_CLASSIFICATIONS.CREATED_AT needs NO shift -- verified empirically (median skew ~seconds, not ~5.5h)
 SELECT MOBILE, CREATED_AT AS ic_ts, USER_STATE, FINALISED_INTENT
 FROM PROD_DB.DYNAMODB_READ.INTENT_CLASSIFICATIONS
 WHERE MOBILE IS NOT NULL
 AND CREATED_AT >= DATEADD('day',-135, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
),
excluded_flag AS ( -- exclude only on a POSITIVE, tight (+-10s) match to an excluded (state,intent) pair; unmatched/unclassified messages stay in denominator
 -- CHANGE: joins to ic on inbound_mobile (unchanged meaning -- ic is mobile-keyed), grouped by acct_id+inbound_ts
 SELECT DISTINCT m.acct_id, m.inbound_ts, 1 AS is_excluded
 FROM matched_reply m
 JOIN ic i ON i.MOBILE = m.inbound_mobile
  AND i.ic_ts BETWEEN DATEADD('second',-10,m.inbound_ts) AND DATEADD('second',10,m.inbound_ts)
 LEFT JOIN excluded_pairs ep ON ep.state_ = i.USER_STATE AND ep.intent_ = i.FINALISED_INTENT
 WHERE i.FINALISED_INTENT IN ('confirmSlot','acknowledgement')
 AND ep.state_ IS NULL
),
base AS (
 SELECT m.acct_id, m.inbound_ts, DATE(m.inbound_ts) AS d,
  CASE WHEN ef.is_excluded=1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS den,
  CASE WHEN ef.is_excluded=1 THEN NULL
       WHEN m.reply_ts IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF('second', m.inbound_ts, m.reply_ts) <= 60 THEN 1
       ELSE 0 END AS num
 FROM matched_reply m
 LEFT JOIN excluded_flag ef ON ef.acct_id = m.acct_id AND ef.inbound_ts = m.inbound_ts
),
elig AS (
 SELECT d, den, num FROM base WHERE den = 1
)
SELECT 'Chat input to output within 1 min' AS kpi,
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-1",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-2",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-3",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-1",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-2",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-3",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-1,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-1",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-2,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-2",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month',d) = DATEADD('month',-3,DATE_TRUNC('month',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "M-3"
FROM elig CROSS JOIN params p;

name: New ticket via chat -> created in ticket system within 5min
description: When the chat bot tells a customer a new complaint ticket has been created (complaint_ticket_type_3_or_4_created workflow), what share of those tickets actually exist in the ticket system within 5 minutes of that message?
query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today,
    DATE('2026-06-17') AS cutover_date
),
tickets AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(CREATED_AT) AS d,
    CREATED_AT AS chat_time,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(FINAL_MESSAGE:content:text::string, '[0-9]{10,}') AS chat_ticket_id
  FROM MESSAGE_ORCHESTRATOR_SERVICE_PUBLIC.MESSAGE_HISTORY
  WHERE WORKFLOW_NAME = 'complaint_ticket_type_3_or_4_created'
    AND _FIVETRAN_DELETED = FALSE
),
csp_new AS (
  SELECT TICKET_ID, MIN(CREATED_AT) AS event_time
  FROM CSP_SUPPORT_RESOLUTION_SERVICE_CSP_SUPPORT_RESOLUTION_SERVICE.COMPLAINTS
  GROUP BY 1
),
-- SERVICE_TICKET_MODEL timestamps are raw UTC (verified empirically: off by exactly 330 min from chat_time)
stm_new AS (
  SELECT TICKET_ID, MIN(TICKET_ADDED_TIME) AS event_time
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.SERVICE_TICKET_MODEL
  GROUP BY 1
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    t.d,
    1 AS den,
    CASE
      WHEN t.d >= p.cutover_date
        THEN CASE WHEN cn.event_time IS NOT NULL AND ABS(DATEDIFF('minute', t.chat_time, cn.event_time)) <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE CASE WHEN sn.event_time IS NOT NULL AND ABS(DATEDIFF('minute', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', t.chat_time), sn.event_time)) <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    END AS num
  FROM tickets t
  CROSS JOIN params p
  LEFT JOIN csp_new cn ON cn.TICKET_ID = t.chat_ticket_id
  LEFT JOIN stm_new sn ON sn.TICKET_ID = t.chat_ticket_id
)
SELECT 'New ticket via chat -> created in ticket system within 5min' AS kpi,
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-1",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-2",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-3",

name: Reopened ticket via chat -> reopened in ticket system within 5min
description: When the chat bot tells a customer their ticket has been reopened (complaint_resolved_ticket_reopened workflow), what share actually show as reopened in the ticket system within 5 minutes of that message?
query:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC','Asia/Kolkata',CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS today,
    DATE('2026-06-17') AS cutover_date
),
tickets AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(CREATED_AT) AS d,
    CREATED_AT AS chat_time,
    REGEXP_SUBSTR(FINAL_MESSAGE:content:text::string, '[0-9]{10,}') AS chat_ticket_id
  FROM MESSAGE_ORCHESTRATOR_SERVICE_PUBLIC.MESSAGE_HISTORY
  WHERE WORKFLOW_NAME = 'complaint_resolved_ticket_reopened'
    AND _FIVETRAN_DELETED = FALSE
),
csp_complaints AS (
  SELECT TICKET_ID, COMPLAINT_ID, MIN(CREATED_AT) AS created_at
  FROM CSP_SUPPORT_RESOLUTION_SERVICE_CSP_SUPPORT_RESOLUTION_SERVICE.COMPLAINTS
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
-- match each reopen chat message to the NEAREST complaint record created at/after it (small buffer for
-- clock skew), not the ticket's first-ever reopen -- avoids mismatching against a stale earlier reopen
-- (1,974 tickets have been reopened more than once; IS_REOPEN/REOPEN_COUNT flags are unreliable)
csp_reopen_matched AS (
  SELECT t.chat_ticket_id, t.chat_time, MIN(c.created_at) AS event_time
  FROM tickets t
  JOIN csp_complaints c
    ON c.TICKET_ID = t.chat_ticket_id
    AND c.created_at >= DATEADD('minute', -2, t.chat_time)
  GROUP BY 1,2
),
-- SERVICE_TICKET_MODEL timestamps are raw UTC; FIRST_REOPENED_TIME only stores the ticket's FIRST-EVER
-- reopen, so a later reopen chat message can show a stale gap here -- unfixable pre-cutover
stm_reopen AS (
  SELECT TICKET_ID, MIN(FIRST_REOPENED_TIME) AS event_time
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.SERVICE_TICKET_MODEL
  WHERE FIRST_REOPENED_TIME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    t.d,
    1 AS den,
    CASE
      WHEN t.d >= p.cutover_date
        THEN CASE WHEN cr.event_time IS NOT NULL AND ABS(DATEDIFF('minute', t.chat_time, cr.event_time)) <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE CASE WHEN sr.event_time IS NOT NULL AND ABS(DATEDIFF('minute', CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', t.chat_time), sr.event_time)) <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    END AS num
  FROM tickets t
  CROSS JOIN params p
  LEFT JOIN csp_reopen_matched cr ON cr.chat_ticket_id = t.chat_ticket_id AND cr.chat_time = t.chat_time
  LEFT JOIN stm_reopen sr ON sr.TICKET_ID = t.chat_ticket_id
)
SELECT 'Reopened ticket via chat -> reopened in ticket system within 5min' AS kpi,
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-1 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-1",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-2 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-2",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d = p.today-3 THEN den END),0)*100 AS "D-3",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-7, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-1, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-1",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-14,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-8, DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-2",
 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN num END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATEADD('day',-21,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) AND DATEADD('day',-15,DATE_TRUNC('week',p.today)) THEN den END),0)*100 AS "W-3",

name: Booking not-installed-14D -> auto-cancelled-by-16D
description: Of bookings still not installed 14 days after the booking fee was paid, what share got automatically cancelled (and refunded) by day 16? Checks whether the auto-cancel sweep job is actually firing on stale bookings.
query:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT
    mat,
    mat - 1 AS d17,
    mat - 2 AS d18,
    DATEADD('day',  -7, DATE_TRUNC('week',  mat)) AS w1f,
    DATEADD('day',  -1, DATE_TRUNC('week',  mat)) AS w1t,
    DATEADD('day', -14, DATE_TRUNC('week',  mat)) AS w2f,
    DATEADD('day',  -8, DATE_TRUNC('week',  mat)) AS w2t,
    DATEADD('day', -21, DATE_TRUNC('week',  mat)) AS w3f,
    DATEADD('day', -15, DATE_TRUNC('week',  mat)) AS w3t,
    DATEADD('month', -1, DATE_TRUNC('month', mat)) AS m1f,
    DATEADD('day',   -1, DATE_TRUNC('month', mat)) AS m1t,
    DATEADD('month', -2, DATE_TRUNC('month', mat)) AS m2f,
    DATEADD('day',   -1, DATEADD('month', -1, DATE_TRUNC('month', mat))) AS m2t,
    DATEADD('month', -3, DATE_TRUNC('month', mat)) AS m3f,
    DATEADD('day',   -1, DATEADD('month', -2, DATE_TRUNC('month', mat))) AS m3t
  FROM (SELECT DATE(DATEADD(minute, 330, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) - 16 AS mat)
),
fee_dedup AS (
  SELECT MOBILE, ADDED_TIME AS FEE_T
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.BOOKING_LOGS
  WHERE EVENT_NAME = 'booking_fee_captured'
    AND MOBILE > '5999999999'
    AND ADDED_TIME >= DATEADD(day, -300, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MOBILE, EVENT_NAME, ADDED_TIME ORDER BY 1) = 1
),
dynb AS (
  SELECT
    MOBILE,
    ADDED_TIME AS CREATED_T,
    MIN(PLAN_START_TIME) AS INST_PLAN,
    MIN(CASE WHEN CANCELLATION_BOOKING_DATE >= ADDED_TIME
             THEN CANCELLATION_BOOKING_DATE END)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS CANC_T,
    MAX(CASE WHEN CANCEL_REASON IN (
                    'Automatic refund after 14 days',
                    'Automatic refund after 15 days and  installation not completed')
              AND CANCELLATION_BOOKING_DATE >= ADDED_TIME
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS IS_AUTO
  FROM PROD_DB.DYNAMODB.BOOKING
  WHERE MOBILE > '5999999999'
    AND ADDED_TIME >= DATEADD(day, -300, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN BOOKING_PAYMENT > 0 AND PAYMENT_STATUS = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
),
cyc AS (
  SELECT d.*,
         LEAD(CREATED_T) OVER (PARTITION BY MOBILE ORDER BY CREATED_T)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS NEXT_T
  FROM dynb d
),
anch AS (
  SELECT c.MOBILE, c.NEXT_T, c.INST_PLAN, c.CANC_T, c.IS_AUTO,
         MIN(f.FEE_T)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS FEE_T
  FROM cyc c
  LEFT JOIN fee_dedup f
    ON f.MOBILE = c.MOBILE
   AND f.FEE_T >= c.CREATED_T::TIMESTAMP_NTZ
   AND (c.NEXT_T IS NULL OR f.FEE_T < c.NEXT_T)
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
),
inst_alt AS (
  SELECT MOBILE, ADDED_TIME::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS I
  FROM PROD_DB.PUBLIC.TASK_LOGS
  WHERE EVENT_NAME = 'OTP_VERIFIED'
    AND MOBILE > '5999999999'
    AND ADDED_TIME >= DATEADD(day, -300, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ct.MOBILE, ic.INSTALLATION_COMPLETED_AT::TIMESTAMP_NTZ
  FROM PROD_DB.CSP_TAS_SERVICE_CSP_TAS_SERVICE.INSTALL_EXECUTION_CANDIDATES ic
  JOIN (SELECT CONNECTION_ID, MAX(CUSTOMER_ID) AS CUSTOMER_ID
        FROM PROD_DB.CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE_CSP_CONNECTION_LIFECYCLE_SERVICE.CONNECTIONS
        WHERE CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) cn
    ON cn.CONNECTION_ID = ic.CONNECTION_ID
  JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, MAX(MOBILE) AS MOBILE
        FROM PROD_DB.CLEVERTAP_CUSTOMER_API.CLEVERTAP_EVENTS
        WHERE CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL AND MOBILE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) ct
    ON ct.CUSTOMER_ID = cn.CUSTOMER_ID
  WHERE ic.INSTALLATION_COMPLETED_AT IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT a.FEE_T, a.CANC_T, a.IS_AUTO, a.INST_PLAN,
         MIN(CASE WHEN ia.I >= a.FEE_T
                   AND (a.NEXT_T IS NULL OR ia.I < a.NEXT_T)
                  THEN ia.I END) AS INST_ALT
  FROM anch a
  LEFT JOIN inst_alt ia ON ia.MOBILE = a.MOBILE
  WHERE a.FEE_T IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(DATEADD(minute, 330, FEE_T)) AS cdate,
    DATEDIFF('hour', FEE_T,
      LEAST(COALESCE(INST_PLAN, '2999-01-01'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ),
            COALESCE(INST_ALT,  '2999-01-01'::TIMESTAMP_NTZ))) / 24.0 AS id,
    DATEDIFF('hour', FEE_T, CANC_T) / 24.0 AS cd,
    IS_AUTO
  FROM joined
),
elig AS (
  SELECT cdate,
         CASE WHEN cd <= 16 AND IS_AUTO = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS swept
  FROM base
  WHERE (id IS NULL OR id > 2000 OR id > 13.95)
    AND (cd IS NULL OR cd > 13.95)
)
SELECT
  'Booking not-installed-14D -> auto-cancelled-by-16D' AS KPI,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate = w.mat THEN swept END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN cdate = w.mat THEN 1 END), 0), 3) AS "D-1",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate = w.d17 THEN swept END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN cdate = w.d17 THEN 1 END), 0), 3) AS "D-2",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate = w.d18 THEN swept END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN cdate = w.d18 THEN 1 END), 0), 3) AS "D-3",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w1f AND w.w1t THEN swept END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w1f AND w.w1t THEN 1 END), 0), 3) AS "W-1",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w2f AND w.w2t THEN swept END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w2f AND w.w2t THEN 1 END), 0), 3) AS "W-2",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w3f AND w.w3t THEN swept END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.w3f AND w.w3t THEN 1 END), 0), 3) AS "W-3",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m1f AND w.m1t THEN swept END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m1f AND w.m1t THEN 1 END), 0), 3) AS "M-1",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m2f AND w.m2t THEN swept END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m2f AND w.m2t THEN 1 END), 0), 3) AS "M-2",
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m3f AND w.m3t THEN swept END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN cdate BETWEEN w.m3f AND w.m3t THEN 1 END), 0), 3) AS "M-3"
FROM elig
CROSS JOIN w
GROUP BY w.mat, w.d17, w.d18, w.w1f, w.w1t, w.w2f, w.w2t, w.w3f, w.w3t,
         w.m1f, w.m1t, w.m2f, w.m2t, w.m3f, w.m3t;
